name: Chocolate Peanut Butter
ingredients:
Roasted Peanuts (64%), Dark Chocolate Paste {Sugar, Vegetable Fat, Cocoa Mass (3%), Cocoa Solids (18%) & Emulsifiers (INS 322 (i) & INS 476]}, Stabilizer (INS 471), Nature Identical (Chocolate) & Artificial (Ethyl Vanillin) Flavouring Substances. 
Allergens: Contains Nut & Soy.
